newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-DATES SET FOR NATIONS CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DATES SET FOR NATIONS CUP.

text.p: The next African Nations' Cup finals will be played in Burkina Faso from February 7-28 next year, the Confederation of African Football (CAF) have confirmed.
The 16-team tournament will be the 21st edition of the African championship and will be played at venues in the capital Ouagadougou and the provincial city of Bobo Dialassou.

The competition has been shifted from its traditional January date to avoid clashing with the Moslem fast of Ramadan, which was a source of complaint at the last African Nations' Cup finals in South Africa last year.
Qualifying for the finals is already underway and will be completed in July. The draw for the finals will be held in Ouagadougou on September 25 this year, CAF said.
